standard-dialogue.npc: What are you doing bothering me? Don't you think some of us have work to do?

standard-dialogue.player: I thought you were here to help?

standard-dialogue.npc: Well... I am, I suppose, anyway... we're very busy here, hurry up, what do you want?

options.text: What is there to do in the Wizards' Guild?

steps.player: What is there to do in the Wizards' Guild?

steps.npc: This is the finest wizards' establishment in the land. We have magic portals to the other towers of wizardry around Gielinor. We have a particularly wide collection of runes in our rune shop. We sell some of the finest
mage robes in the land and we have a training area full of zombies for you to practice your magic on.

options.text: What are the requirements to get in the Wizards' Guild?

steps.player: What are the requirements to get in the Wizards' Guild?

steps.npc: You need a magic level of 66, the high magic energy level is too dangerous for anyone below that level.

options.text: What do you do in the Guild?

steps.player: What do you do in the Guild?

steps.npc: I'm the Grand Secretary for the Wizards' Guild, I have lots of correspondence to keep up with, as well as attending to the discipline of the more problematic guild members.

standard-dialogue-when-ringing-the-bell.text: Zavistic appears next to the player.

standard-dialogue-when-ringing-the-bell.npc: What are you doing ringing that bell?! Don't you think some of us have work to do?

standard-dialogue-when-ringing-the-bell.player: But I was told to ring the bell if I wanted some attention.

standard-dialogue-when-ringing-the-bell.npc: Well...anyway...we're very busy here, hurry up what do you want?

standard-dialogue-after-hand-in-the-sand.npc: What are you doing...Oh, it's you...sorry...didn't realise...what can I do for you?
Thank you so much for helping to lay Clarence to rest and lock up his murderer!
